fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 5% on first $1,500,000 of annual Gross Sales; 4.5% on annual Gross Sales from $1,500,000.01 to $2,000,000; 4% on annual Gross Sales of $2,000,000.01 or more. Due the 7th day of each month. If the Licensed Restaurant is subject to laws prohibiting royalty collection on alcoholic beverage sales (beer and wine only), the applicable Continuing Royalty Rate is increased by 2% and applies to Gross Sales excluding such alcoholic beverage sales. Advertising Fee is 1.5% of Gross Sales, due same day as royalty. Cooperative Advertising contribution may be up to 1.5% of Gross Sales per month (as determined by Co-op Advertising Region); credited against local advertising requirement of 1% of Gross Sales per year (or 0.5% for second or subsequent Franchise Agreement). No minimum monthly royalty or marketing floor disclosed. Tech/software fees (Software Support Fee, Intranet Maintenance Fee) are undisclosed amounts determined by franchisor.
